newsitem.title: INDIA: Pop star Jackson to tour India next month.
newsitem.headline: Pop star Jackson to tour India next month.

text.p: Pop star Michael Jackson will perform at two concerts in India's commercial capital next month in the first ever tour of the country, the organisers said on Friday.
Wizcraft said in a statement that Jackson, currently in Prague on the start of his three-month, four-continent "HIStory" tour, will perform in Bombay on October 30 and November 1.
The pop star, to be accompanied by an entourage of 180 people, will perform free for the sake of a local charity organisation, the entertainment agency said.
Jackson's concerts in India are part of the Asian leg of the HIStory tour dubbed as the pop star's biggest ever.
